source.author: verg
source.text: Olli membra novus solvit formidine torpor, arrectaeque horrore comae, et vox faucibus haesit.
source.text_original: Olli membra novus solvit formidine torpor, / arrectaeque horrore comae, et vox faucibus haesit.
source.text_english: Then a new numbness with fear loosened his limbs, his hair stood on end with horror, and his voice stuck in his throat.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: haesit uox faucibus et inter ruborem atque pallorem metumque ac laetitiam cogitationes uariae mutabantur.
reuse.text_original: haesit uox faucibus et inter ruborem atque pallorem metumque ac laetitiam cogitationes uariae mutabantur.
reuse.text_english: His voice stuck in his throat, and between blush and pallor, fear and joy, his thoughts kept changing.
